visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in front of a mirror, taking a selfie with her smartphone. She wears an off-the-shoulder white lace top and light blue jeans, pointing at her shoulders while smiling brightly. (2) A fast-paced montage follows, showing various K-pop female idols performing on stage with sharp, straight shoulders. They wear stage costumes and dance under bright colorful lights. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior of a modern high-rise building in Seoul, South Korea, with large signage for 'View Plastic Surgery'. The woman is seen waving at the camera and entering the glass doors. (4) Inside the clinic, the camera shows a sleek reception area and a detailed floor directory list. The environment is well-lit with professional studio-style lighting. (5) The woman is now in a consultation room, sitting on a gray sofa. A female doctor in a white lab coat and blue surgical mask uses a professional marker to point out areas on the woman's shoulder and arm during the face-to-face consultation. (6) A collection of medical certificates, trophies, and skincare products are displayed on purple shelves, highlighting the clinic's credentials. The woman and doctor pose for a photo together, making heart gestures with their fingers. (7) In the procedure room, the doctor sanitizes the woman's shoulder area and administers a local anesthetic. The woman sits calmly as the doctor performs the hyaluronic acid injection on her shoulder. (8) A close-up view shows the doctor performing a fat-dissolving injection on the woman's upper arm. The woman remains composed throughout the process. (9) Post-procedure, the woman looks at herself in a black hand mirror with a satisfied expression. A side-by-side comparison screen appears, showing the visual difference in her shoulder line before and after the treatment. (10) A final montage shows the woman taking selfies in various fashionable outfits and different locations like a subway, a street, and a cafe, confidently displaying her new shoulder shape. (11) The woman walks into a modern, minimalist cafe located on the first floor of the clinic. She shows the interior seating area and finally takes a selfie while holding her phone, looking very happy.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 female doctor, 1 female assistant, 2 male clinic staff/passers-by, and K-pop idols in video-in-video clips.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long brown hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder lace ruffled top and light-colored high-waisted denim jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a professional medical clinic (clean white walls, medical equipment), bustling Seoul city streets with high-rise buildings, and a modern minimalist cafe interior with dark counters and stylish gray chairs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over a bright, upbeat electronic pop background track with a driving 4/4 house beat. The voice is enthusiastic and well-enunciated. (2) As the narrator describes the clinic's credentials, the BGM continues with consistent energy. No audible background noise from the clinic environment is present, indicating a studio-style voiceover track. (3) During the description of the medical procedure, the vocal pitch remains high and positive, while subtle digital 'ding' SFX punctuate key information points. The BGM remains steady in tempo and volume. (4) The audio concludes with a cheerful sign-off from the narrator, the music maintains its energetic rhythm until a quick fade-out at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Introduction -> Clinic Overview -> Professional Consultation -> Procedure Demonstration -> Result Comparison -> Lifestyle Application -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for View Plastic Surgery in Seoul, aiming to showcase the ease and effectiveness of their non-surgical shoulder contouring procedures (hyaluronic acid and fat-dissolving injections) to achieve a 'right-angle shoulder' aesthetic popular among K-pop idols.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly visits the clinic, mentions the doctor by name, shows the procedures being performed, and includes the clinic's logo and social media handles prominently.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density subtitles and upbeat music to maintain high engagement, specifically targeting young female viewers interested in East Asian beauty standards.
